cases.name: v4:large_random_sequence
cases.code:
import random
rnd = random.Random(0)
ml = sol.MergeLedger()
names = ["n%d" % i for i in range(120)]
for n in names:
    ml.add(n, 1)
log = []
depth = 0
for i in range(1500):
    op = rnd.random()
    if op < 0.5:
        a = rnd.choice(names); b = rnd.choice(names)
        res = ml.merge(a, b)
        if res:
            depth += 1
        log.append(res)
    elif op < 0.7 and depth > 0:
        ml.undo()
        depth -= 1
    elif op < 0.85:
        ml.add_value(rnd.choice(names), 1)
    else:
        a = rnd.choice(names); b = rnd.choice(names)
        log.append([ml.same(a, b), ml.component_size(a), ml.component_value(b)])
    if i % 200 == 0:
        log.append(ml.components())
result = [log, ml.components(),
          sorted([ml.component_size(n), ml.component_value(n)] for n in names)]
